tool.name: Biomni: Model Bacterial Growth Dynamics
tool.description: Model bacterial population dynamics over time using ordinary differential equations.
tool.command:
python -c " import sys import json from biomni.tool.microbiology import model_bacterial_growth_dynamics
# Parse arguments args = {} i = 1 while i < len(sys.argv): if sys.argv[i].startswith('--'): key = sys.argv[i][2:] if i + 1 < len(sys.argv) and not sys.argv[i + 1].startswith('--'): val = sys.argv[i + 1] # Type conversion if val.lower() == 'true': val = True elif val.lower() == 'false': val = False else: try: val = int(val) except: try: val = float(val) except: pass args[key] = val i += 2 else: args[key] = True i += 1 else: i += 1
# Call function result = model_bacterial_growth_dynamics(**args)
# Write output output_path = args.get('output', '/dev/stdout') with open(output_path, 'w') as f: if isinstance(result, str): f.write(result) elif isinstance(result, (dict, list)): json.dump(result, f, indent=2, default=str) else: f.write(str(result)) " --output '$output' --initial_population '$initial_population' --growth_rate '$growth_rate' --clearance_rate '$clearance_rate' --niche_size '$niche_size' #if $simulation_time --simulation_time '$simulation_time' #end if #if $time_step --time_step '$time_step' #end if

param.name: initial_population
param.label: Initial Population
param.help: Initial bacterial population size (CFU/ml or cells)

param.name: clearance_rate
param.label: Clearance Rate
param.help: Rate at which bacteria are cleared from the system (per hour)

param.name: niche_size
param.label: Niche Size
param.help: Maximum carrying capacity of the environment (CFU/ml or cells)

tool.help:
**Biomni: Model Bacterial Growth Dynamics**
Model bacterial population dynamics over time using ordinary differential equations.
Parameters ---------- initial_population : float Initial bacterial population size (CFU/ml or cells) growth_rate : float Bacterial growth rate (per hour) clearance_rate : float Rate at which bacteria are cleared from the system (per hour) niche_size : float Maximum carrying capacity of the environment (CFU/ml or cells) simulation_time : float, optional Total simulation time in hours (default: 24) time_step : float, optional Time step for simulation output (default: 0.1)
Returns ------- str Research log summarizing the bacterial growth dynamics simulation
**Domain**: microbiology **Function**: model_bacterial_growth_dynamics
